meta.note: One row per string. The controller reads this file too, so a refuse.* code the controller can send must have a row here.

boot.lede.en: Two of you, one valley, one night. You each hear which direction a radio collar is in. Neither of you can tell how far away it is.

boot.rule.en: One bearing is a line. Two bearings are a place.

boot.offline.en: The field station is not on the air yet. Practice works offline in the meantime.

lobby.copyBlocked.en: Could not copy. Read the code out instead.

lobby.hint.en: Send it to whoever you are playing with. The night starts the moment they arrive, with nothing to press.

train.caption.en: Practice plate · one collar · station A

train.help.en: Drag across the plate to swing the antenna, or tap a mark on the ring. Arrow keys step one degree, shift-arrow five.

train.result.en: You said {said}. It was {truth}. Off by {err} degrees.

train.geomHelp.en: Now both stations hear it, and both are off by the same few degrees. Drag either station. Nothing about the antennas changes, only where you stand.

train.helpSweep.en: Drag across the plate to swing the antenna. The number follows your aim and SIG is what you can hear there. Sweep until a clear hump appears on the trace.

train.helpGate.en: Now drag the gate line up and down the trace. The instrument brackets the hump where it crosses the gate and reads the midpoint, because the flanks are steep where the peak is flat. Watch the plus-or-minus: get it as small as you can, then commit.

night.pickCell.en: Tap a cell on the plate.

night.pickSweep.en: Pick a collar to sweep. One that is silent this cycle wastes it.

night.helpMove.en: Tap where to walk, up to six cells. You reveal the ground you cross, and only you will know it.

night.helpLog.en: Tap where you think she is right now. A fix is not a score, it is one dot on the track you are drawing, and three of them show you her shape.

night.objective.en: Both collars, one clean intercept each, before dawn.

night.traceFrom.en: Trace from station {seat}. Bracket it, then post.

night.noTrace.en: Sweep a collar to put a trace on the recorder.

night.shapeHint.en: A hunch costs nothing and binds nothing. It is here so you two can disagree about it.

night.helpCall.en: Tap where {collar} will be, and say when. Your partner has to agree before it counts, and one of you must be standing within {radius} cells of it by then.

night.callFree.en: Calling costs no cycle. Pick Sweep, Walk or Log a fix to spend this one.

night.attendWalk.en: {cycles} cycles of walking to be there

night.attendNever.en: Neither of you can reach it in time

weather.haze.en: Haze. Everything is a little quieter tonight.

weather.storm.en: Storm. Loud hiss, and ridges throw a convincing echo.

dawn.triumph.en: Both of them, in the dark, from a direction each. That is the whole job done.

dawn.good.en: One clean contact. You read one of them properly and ran out of night for the other.

dawn.partial.en: Close on one. Near enough to know you were reading her right, not near enough to touch.

dawn.disaster.en: Nothing landed. Either the fixes were too loose to show a shape, or nobody was standing there when it mattered.

refuse.badCode.en: That is not a room code.

refuse.badName.en: Pick a name between one and twenty characters.

refuse.roomFull.en: That room already has two stations.

refuse.started.en: That night is already under way.

refuse.network.en: Could not reach the field station. Check your connection.

refuse.alreadyCommitted.en: You have already committed this cycle.

refuse.tooFar.en: Too far to walk in one cycle.

refuse.badAction.en: That is not something a station can do.

refuse.badProfile.en: That is not one of the four shapes.

refuse.badCycle.en: Call a cycle that is still ahead of you.

refuse.callPending.en: You already have a call standing on that collar.

refuse.noCall.en: That call is no longer on the table.

refuse.needPartner.en: You cannot agree with yourself. Your partner has to second it.

refuse.callStale.en: That cycle has already gone past.

refuse.seatTaken.en: That seat was taken by another device.
